plugin.name: OraDbCodeGen-v4.2
plugin.description:
Create PL/SQL packages from Class Models. To create a function that returns a ref cursors (an approximation of a parameterized view), model a class, called here dbpk1, that contains an operation (called here gd1) that returns a class, calle here Proc1RecType. Proc1RecType must have the stereotype 'OracleDbRecType' (create such a stereotype, if needed). The outcome is a set of procs within a PL/SQL database package, named according to the class name, that can be called in the form:
select * from schem.dbpk1.gd1( schem.util.gd1RefC( p1 => ??, p2 => ?? ) );
